## Checklist

- [ ] The change is linked to an issue or has a clearly bounded rationale.
- [ ] Imported history and published upstream tags were not rewritten.
- [ ] New third-party code or artifacts have traceable source and compatible licensing.
- [ ] Tests or reproducibility checks cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no secrets or private data.
- [ ] Security, upgrade, rollback, and release-note impact were considered.
- [ ] Documentation was updated, or no documentation change is needed.
